multiday_days_count.context: Number of days of a multi-day tour: My routes row ("6 Tage · 564 km · Fahrrad") and the plan sheet's overview title

multiday_day_of.context: Navigate's top card and the day's plan sheet while one day is followed: %1$s = day, %2$s = number of days ("Tag 4 von 6", sketch round 2)

multiday_days_of.context: As multiday_day_of for several days in a row: %1$s–%2$s of %3$s

multiday_ride_day.context: The plan sheet's one button in the overview: the picked day becomes the plan (sketch round 2: "Tag 4 fahren")

multiday_ride_days.context: As multiday_ride_day for several days in a row (picked by holding a second day row)

multiday_pick.context: The plan sheet's button in the overview while no day row is picked (not pressable)

multiday_all_days.context: Small pill in the day's plan sheet: back to the whole tour's overview (not during a tour)

multiday_maps_missing.context: Tag on a multi-day tour's row in My routes: map areas along it are not on the phone (sketch round 2)

multiday_maps_title.context: Question box at the first opening of a multi-day tour (concept §7), title

multiday_maps_wifi.context: Added to the detail on mobile data: the maps load once on Wi-Fi

multiday_maps_whole.context: Button of the question: load all map areas of the tour; %1$s = size ("340 MB")

multiday_maps_day.context: Button of the question: load only one day's maps; %1$s = day, %2$s = size

multiday_maps_later.context: Button of the question: nothing loads now (My routes keeps the "Karten fehlen" tag; picking a day checks again)

multiday_day_maps_missing.context: Line in the day's plan sheet after a day was picked and its maps are not all there; %1$s = size; tap = load

multiday_load.context: Tap word at the end of multiday_day_maps_missing

multiday_end_open.context: Screen reader text of the grey moon at a day end (a worked-out proposal, round 3 variant A)

multiday_end_overnight.context: Screen reader text of the blue moon at a day end (glossary: Übernachtung)

multiday_end_hotel.context: Screen reader text of the green bed at a day end (glossary: Hotel)

multiday_end_finish.context: Screen reader text of the last day's end (the tour's finish)
